sections.h2: Mobiltech imports ran more than double automotive-textile exports in FY2025-26

chart.title: Imports of ₹6,004 crore outran automotive-textile exports of ₹2,704 crore
chart.source: Technical Textiles Today, as cited in the post; not checked against official data.

sections.means: Trade-press figures put mobiltech imports at more than double automotive-textile exports, a real net deficit on the chapter figures alone.
sections.todo: Check the ₹6,004 crore import figure against Ministry of Textiles or DGCI&S data before relying on it.

sections.h2: Three programmes fund textiles broadly, and none names seat belts, airbags or tyre cord

chart.title: Outlays go to general textile schemes; none names seat belts, airbags or tyre cord
chart.sub: Outlay per programme, ₹ crore. The mission figure is its total for 2020-21 to 2025-26.

sections.means: The three programmes are broad textile schemes, and none carves out seat belts, airbags or tyre cord fabric by name.
sections.todo: Confirm which of the ₹4,445 crore PM MITRA parks, if any, host restraint-system fabric makers before counting on them.

sections.h2: Growth estimates for mobiltech and seat belts sit between 8.84% and 10.35% a year

chart.title: The seat belt estimate of 9.2% sits between the two mobiltech growth rates
chart.sub: Growth rate, % a year, from the post's sources.
chart.source: Technical Textiles Today; Markets&Data/UnivDatos; industry estimate, as cited in the post.

sections.means: Growth estimates for mobiltech run from 8.84% to 10.35% a year, and the seat belt webbing estimate of 9.2% falls inside that range.
sections.todo: Treat these as vendor and programme estimates, not audited figures, when planning around growth.
